text:
maya: Morning async — quick standup.
- Did: ran keyscan across prod/staging, triaged CVE-2025-1144 affecting the vpn proxy, kicked off KMS rotation dry run in staging, and fixed an IAM permission mismatch for redwood-agent.
- Blockers: rotation intermittently fails with 502 from keystore; suspect egress/NAT or transient keystore load. Need infra help to check staging NAT capacity.
- Today: finish rotation dry run, open PR for iam fix, coordinate with infra on NAT scaling, prepare audit export for compliance.

raj: ok saw the 502s earlier. quick check: NAT instance in staging is at 95% conn limit. scaling up now, should be up in ~10–15m.

simone: can you paste the exact error snippet when you have a sec? I want to add a targeted test to the export/eval harness.

maya: logging excerpt:
```
2025-05-10T09:12:14Z keystore_client.go:142 error: failed to rotate key: status=502 body=\"bad gateway\"\nrpc: timeout waiting for response\nattempts=3
```

raj: thanks — that's the same pattern I saw. scaling started (ASG +1), monitoring the connection queue. will update RW ticket.

linh: small perms note — redwood-agent's role currently only has iam:AssumeRole. Rotation workflow needs iam:PassRole for the delegated rotation lambda. I put a tiny change in PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/1247 (adds minimal PassRole scope).

maya: nice, will review. if anyone else sees a missing permission in staging, ping me.

simone: compliance ask: they want a 30-day audit export (csv) of key rotations + IAM changes. suggestion: run export after the rotation dry run completes to capture consistent snapshot. example call:
```
curl -X POST "https://ops.example/api/v1/audit/export" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"days":30,"format":"csv","scope":["kms","iam"]}'
```

maya: perfect. Simone — can you queue that once rotation is green? I'll attach to the compliance ticket.

simone: yes, will queue after I see the final rotation success event.

ops-bot: Ticket RW-45321 created and assigned to raj: "KMS rotation 502 errors (staging)" — https://tickets.company/RW-45321

raj: assigned and acknowledged, adding notes about NAT scaling and monitoring rules. will follow up in ticket if we see more failures. :white_check_mark:

maya: fallback plan: if rotations still fail after NAT scale, flip to kms-secondary for the dry run and alert @oncall, then dig deeper.

simone: responded — running a quick embed eval on staging as part of the post-rotation checks; found a tiny perf regression tied to quantization flags. opened PR to revert the flag: https://git.company/repo/pull/1250

linh: i'll review both PRs later today. if anyone needs me to pair on IAM tests, ping.

maya: thanks — short follow-ups: 1) raj, post ticket update when NAT is steady; 2) simone, queue export once rotation completes; 3) linh, review PRs. otherwise i'm unblocked for the compliance doc prep. :thumbsup:

raj: will update in ~12m.

simone: noted, will post export job id here.

maya: cool. closing this async loop — ping here if anything urgent pops up.
